findings.detection: generated index contains content_refs entries that are not keys in the specs map
findings.detail: New refs such as `speclang/examples/auth` (in @speclang/examples/api), `speclang/examples/api` (in @speclang/examples/auth), and `speclang/examples/hello-world#greet`/`#farewell` (in @speclang/examples-spec-dir/hello-world-cascade) point at IDs that do not exist as spec entries, unlike the surrounding refs which resolve to real spec IDs.

findings.detection: reverse dependency map keys must correspond to forward content_refs; new reverse entries are added for refs that were removed from the forward lists
findings.detail: The reverse map gains `speclang/examples/api -> @speclang/examples/auth` and `speclang/examples/auth -> @speclang/examples/api` (mutual), plus `speclang/examples-spec-dir/hello-world-cascade -> @speclang/examples-spec`, while the corresponding forward content_refs for those specs were changed to different targets, so the two halves of the index disagree.

findings.detection: spec entry renamed from @unknown/index.spec.md to @specs/agents/implementation but the file field still points at agents.spec.dir/index.spec.md
findings.detail: The entry's `file` remains `agents.spec.dir/index.spec.md` while its id/short/tags now describe an agents implementation spec, and its content_refs changed from `specs/agent-protocol---` to `specs/agent-protocol`, indicating the id was rewritten without the underlying file identity being reconciled.

findings.detection: new spec entries added to specs map but not registered in the top-level spec list
findings.detail: `@specs/docs/nasa-se-playbook` and `@specs/skills/nasa-spec-style` are added to the `specs` map and reverse map, but the top-level ordering list (where `@bugs/integration-test-template`, `@demo/hello-dir`, `@specs/docs/changelog`, `@examples/greeting-dir` were inserted) does not include them, so the list and map are out of sync.

review.summary: The regenerated _index.json introduces several dangling/renamed content_refs (notably the new speclang/examples/* targets) and forward/reverse dependency-map inconsistencies, plus new spec entries missing from the top-level list.
